copy.intro: Your Original Zip Hipster ($80) has three zippered compartments, and you know exactly where your keys are. Now you'd like that same order in nylon, leather or canvas, or just a print nobody else at school pickup is carrying. These brands sell totes, crossbodies and backpacks from Vera Bradley's price range up to leather, sorted with the closest matches first.

bodies.jansport:
JanSport is the pick if it's a Vera Bradley backpack you're replacing and you'd like to spend less. The SuperBreak Plus ($45) has an internal laptop sleeve and a side water bottle pocket, for about a third of the price of a Bancroft Backpack ($135).

It's been making packs since 1967, and the warranty is the useful part. If a pack ever breaks down, JanSport fixes it, or replaces it when it can't. For something small, the Half Pint Mini Backpack ($27) costs less than half a Kimmel Sling Crossbody ($60). US orders ship free over $50, half Vera Bradley's $99.

Backpacks make up most of the range. For a shoulder bag with the same zip-pocket thinking, Kipling has far more to choose from.
bodies.dooney-bourke:
Dooney & Bourke is where to go when you're ready to trade cotton for leather. It's a Connecticut bagmaker that began in 1975, and its Heritage Collection uses Italian leather with the duck logo.

Start with the Pebble Grain Luna Hobo ($218), a zip-top hobo with an inside key hook, which costs less than Vera Bradley's leather Original Vera Tote ($270). Under $100 there's only the Canvas Carryall 50 ($75), and the typical bag runs $278. It also makes NFL, MLB and college team bags from $188, handy if game day is where your bag goes most.

Standard US shipping costs $10.50 and returns carry a flat $10 fee, so budget for both. For leather with free US returns, Rebecca Minkoff puts a label in the box.
bodies.fable-england:
Fable England is the closest match on price, and it loves a busy print as much as Vera Bradley does. Its typical bag costs $110, the same as Vera Bradley's. The Into the Woods Tote Bag ($122) is its bestselling tote, with a printed scarf tied around the handle and a little bee plaque.

The prints are the reason to come here. The London label began when its founder found a 1940s bee-print scarf at a vintage fair. The Green Into the Woods Grab Tote ($84) is the cheaper way in, its forest print showing a fox, a doe and an owl under a crescent moon.

The US store has its own dollar prices, higher than the UK ones, so don't compare against pounds. US orders ship free over $80. It makes few backpacks, though, so look at Kipling for one.
bodies.kipling:
Kipling is the pick for Vera Bradley's pockets in a lighter, water-resistant fabric. Its bags are crinkle nylon, the featherlight material three Antwerp designers found in 1987. The Gabbie Small Crossbody Bag ($109) is built around multiple zip pockets, a lot like the Original Zip Hipster ($80).

For school or work, the Seoul Large 15" Laptop Backpack ($134) is its best seller, with a protective laptop sleeve, a dollar under the Bancroft Backpack. Look for the furry monkey keychain, its signature, and each one has a name. Free US shipping starts at $99, the same as Vera Bradley.

Returns cost $8.95 and there are no exchanges, so you send it back and order again. For a backpack under $50, JanSport is the cheaper route.
bodies.spartina-449:
For coastal prints on a bag you'll use every day, go to Spartina 449. It's a Hilton Head Island handbag company that started in 2009, and it pairs linen and leather with colorful patterns. The Market Tote Sea Islands ($78) is laminated cotton, so it wipes clean after the beach or the market.

Those Market Totes are its best sellers, printed with map illustrations of places like the Sea Islands and the Blue Ridge Mountains. Above them sits the Siren leather line, which reaches $398. You can also walk into its own stores in Savannah, Sarasota or St. Augustine.

Free shipping needs $150, the highest bar here, and its prepaid return label costs $9.95. For printed totes with an easier threshold, SCOUT ships free at $99.
bodies.sol-and-selene:
Sol and Selene is the pick for a lighter tote that still holds your devices and a journal. The Los Angeles-designed label specializes in lightweight, functional bags, and many are woven neoprene. The Sky's The Limit - Medium Tote ($150) wears as a crossbody or on the arm.

If it's Vera Bradley's quilted look you like, the Dreamer Tote ($120) is durable nylon with a quilted design, side pockets and an interior zip pocket. Shipping is free across the continental US with no minimum, and you get one free exchange per order.

Its typical bag costs $150, more than Vera Bradley's $110, and returns cost $4.99. If you'd rather pay under $70 for a quilted tote, BAGSMART's Paz 23L Tote is the one.
bodies.dakine:
Dakine makes commuter and campus backpacks with the laptop sleeve built in. It started on Maui's North Shore in 1979 making surf leashes, and it's now based in Hood River, Oregon. The Campus Backpack 25L ($75) is its best seller, with a padded laptop sleeve and an insulated pocket, and the body is mostly recycled polyester.

For something smaller, the Jive Crossbody ($29) is its popular everyday purse, on a wide strap that holds it close to your body. Its typical bag costs $68, against Vera Bradley's $110. US shipping is free over $99, except to Hawaii and Alaska.

Returns cost a flat $10.95, and sale items can't go back at all. If a lifetime repair promise matters more than the extra pockets, JanSport offers one.
bodies.scout-bags:
SCOUT is the closest thing to Vera Bradley's collectable patterns, at a lower price. The Washington, DC brand makes its bags in what it calls life-proof fabrics. The Original Deano Tote Large ($55) has been its best seller since 2004, an open-top tote for work, the pool or sports gear.

For daily carry, the Uptown Pocket Tote ($49) is slim and structured, with four large outside pockets, and it's popular with teachers and nurses. The Bagette Market Tote ($35) holds twice what a typical grocery bag does. Its typical bag costs $65, and shipping is free over $99.

It's nearly all totes, with a single crossbody and no backpacks. For a backpack, JanSport or Dakine fits better.
bodies.bagsmart:
BAGSMART is the pick if Vera Bradley's travel pieces are what you buy most. It's a travel-accessories brand, and the Paz 23L Tote ($69.99) is slightly padded with quilted detail and split into 10 compartments.

The Coast Sling Bag ($36.99) is a water-bottle crossbody that packs flat when you're done, so it slips into a suitcase for the trip home. And the Faro Daypack 26 ($74.99) is the backpack to look at. Its priciest bag, the Moss Backpack ($89.99), still costs less than Vera Bradley's typical $110 bag.

Returns run 30 days, but return shipping on anything you just don't want is on you. For quilted nylon one step up, Sol and Selene's Dreamer Tote costs $120.
bodies.sea-bags:
Sea Bags makes its totes by hand in Maine from recycled sails, so every one comes with a story. It's been cutting old sails into bags since 1999, and an audit verified its totes and bucket bags are all recycled sail content. The Navy Anchor on Chambray Medium Tote ($175) is the classic nautical look.

For a smaller everyday bag, the Lupine on Sailor Stripe Essential Handbag ($95) has a magnetic closure and sail cloth pockets inside. Its typical bag costs $180, a step up from Vera Bradley's $110, and that's the handwork you're paying for.

The 60-day return window is the longest here, and its own stores take returns too. But you pay return shipping unless the bag is faulty. For a cheaper printed tote, SCOUT starts at $35.
bodies.ban-do:
ban.do is the cheapest way to get a quilted floral tote. The Quilted Tote - Blue Scandinavian Floral ($29.95) has a quilted cotton outside and a quilted nylon lining. That's well under half the price of a Mini Hathaway Tote ($75).

It started in 2008 to make things that make people smile, so its own bags are cheerful canvas totes like the Canvas Tote Bag - Library Card ($20.95). Its bags page stocks a lot of Baggu too, so check the label if you want ban.do's own. US shipping is free over $75.

The catch is range. It's totes and market bags only, so for a crossbody or a backpack in a print, Kipling or Fable England has more.
bodies.rebecca-minkoff:
Rebecca Minkoff is where to go if you're ready to swap prints for leather and suede. It calls itself accessible luxury, and its bags lean on rich leathers and signature hardware. The Megan Shoulder Bag ($228) is compact suede with its signature dog-clip detail.

The Darren Shoulder Bag ($378) is its everyday bag, in suede with an interior zip pocket. Its typical bag costs $313, nearly three times Vera Bradley's, the most expensive typical price on this list.

US returns are free with the label in the box, where Vera Bradley takes $6 for its own. If you want leather for under $250, Dooney & Bourke's Pebble Grain Luna Hobo costs $218.

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body: Start with what you liked about Vera Bradley. If it was the prints, Fable England matches its typical price, and Spartina 449 and SCOUT put coastal and collectable patterns on everyday totes. If it was the pockets, Kipling's crossbodies and BAGSMART's Paz 23L Tote are built around compartments. For a backpack, JanSport is the cheapest and repairs its packs for life, while Dakine's Campus adds an insulated pocket. Ready for leather? Dooney & Bourke starts lower than Rebecca Minkoff. And if all you want is a quilted tote, ban.do's costs $29.95.

faqs.q: How much is a Vera Bradley backpack?
faqs.a: Most regular-price Vera Bradley backpacks cost between $49 and $210, and the typical one is about $145. The Bancroft Backpack is $135. JanSport's SuperBreak Plus ($45) and Dakine's Campus Backpack 25L ($75) cost less.
faqs.source_query: how much is a vera bradley backpack

faqs.q: What type of material is Vera Bradley?
faqs.a: Mostly cotton. Most of its regular-price bags are cotton, which it calls Premium Cotton, and the rest include its lighter Featherweight fabric, denim, corduroy and a small leather line at $125 to $270.

faqs.q: Is Vera Bradley a luxury brand?
faqs.a: Not by price. Its typical regular-price bag costs $110, and most of the range is cotton. Leather brands like Dooney & Bourke and Rebecca Minkoff charge about two and a half to three times that for a typical bag.
faqs.source_query: is vera bradley a luxury brand

faqs.a: For shoppers, Kipling and BAGSMART are the closest for organized everyday bags, and JanSport and Dakine for backpacks. Fable England, Spartina 449 and SCOUT cover printed totes, and Dooney & Bourke is the step up to leather.
